name: Ngoc Son Temple
kicker: The temple on the island in Hoan Kiem
summary: Cross the red The Huc bridge from the Hoan Kiem path to the small temple on the island, renovated in 1864 and dedicated to Tran Hung Dao and Van Xuong. Light incense in the court and look back at the lake. It is the one ticketed stop on the lake walk, and it stays open late at weekends.
getThere: Cross the The Huc bridge from the lake path
heroCaption: The The Huc bridge to Ngoc Son Temple

notice.title: Open late at weekends
notice.body: The temple stays open until 22:00 on Saturdays and Sundays.

body: The Huc bridge is the red bridge to the island; the name means where the morning sun rests. Nguyen Van Sieu renovated the temple in 1864, and it worships Tran Hung Dao and Van Xuong. The lake path around it is a separate, free walk.
Go after the lake loop, or come back on a weekend evening when the bridge and the temple court stay open until 22:00. Under 16 is free.

figures.caption: Incense at the temple court, under the tiled roof
figures.alt: A visitor at the incense burner in Ngoc Son Temple

gettingThere: Walk the Hoan Kiem path to the red The Huc bridge. The bridge is the entrance to the temple on the island.

legs.heading: From the lake path
legs.body: Walk to the The Huc bridge. The ticket starts at the island.

hours: Mon–Thu 7:00–19:00, Fri–Sun and holidays 7:00–22:00 (management board); Mon–Fri 7:00–18:00, Sat–Sun 7:00–22:00 (Vietnam Tourism).
admissionNote: Adult 50,000 VND on both sources. The management board, from 1 January 2024, also prints half price 25,000 VND and free under 16.
